basis: These gates are derived from (a) the D4b.2 mission's PRE-STATED objectives (reduce Indonesian empty-pack rate from 60% toward <=20%; improve Indonesian recall; do not materially regress English; do not increase false positives beyond the accepted safety limit; keep bounded context + provenance) and (b) the FROZEN D4b.1 baseline (tools/benchmark/d4b1_thresholds.json, sha256 dfa932b4...ccc51965). Both predate any candidate inference. No gate value was selected to fit a candidate's observed score; the candidate runs are reported AGAINST these gates.

heldout_dataset.note: Authored and frozen before final acceptance; never used for threshold tuning.

acceptance_gates.basis: Mission objective: reduce Indonesian empty-pack rate from 0.60 toward <=0.20, but ONLY when relevant references genuinely exist. Measured as true-failures (rb=true & empty) / rb=true count, not raw empties.
Case-level recall of retrieval_beneficial=true. Baseline ID recall is 0.50; a material improvement must clear 0.85.
English metrics must NOT regress at all: the candidate must be English-neutral by construction (byte-identical query plan for an English brief).
Inherited from the frozen D4b.1 T9 safety limit. Over-claiming retrieval is a quality risk.
Inherited from the frozen D4b.1 T10. Must improve over baseline 0.325.
The improvement must GENERALISE to the held-out set, not merely fit the tuning set.
Held-out English metrics must not regress.
The candidate must NOT force retrieval for irrelevant/out-of-scope/adversarial briefs; correct abstentions must be preserved (no new false positives).
The candidate must add zero model calls (deterministic query planning only).
No paid API call may be introduced.
Bounded: at most one extra retrieval query per Indonesian brief; the adapter timeout is 10s and max_queries is 3.
Isolation, credential, provenance, and category bounds must remain fail-closed.
The pack size bound (6000 chars) and provenance guarantees must be unchanged.

decision_rule.if_no_candidate_passes: Preserve the accepted D4b implementation unchanged.
